scope: Public EPIC validation diagnostic; three fixed recordings; no training or tuning; not official scoring
limitations: Three short kitchen recordings, not a representative or blind benchmark.
Public validation split was also used by the checkpoint authors for evaluation/model selection; none of these recordings are in EPIC training CSV.
TSM has 97 verb and 300 noun classes; CLIP uses the existing 528 action-pair vocabulary. This compares complete recognizers, not architecture alone.
No human highlight labels or category labels evaluated; no Samsung kit, validator or official score.
TSM uses full-frame padding, fixed four-second contexts and one-second output bins; no ground-truth boundaries or local training.
